edition.title: St. John Damascene on Holy Images, Followed by Three Sermons on the Assumption

alternate_titles: Homiliae in Dormitionem Beatae Mariae Virginis
work.author: John of Damascus
work.description: The three eighth-century homilies of John of Damascus for the feast of the Dormition, among the fullest early Greek witnesses to the belief that the Virgin's body did not see corruption. Cited by homily; the nineteenth-century English translation used here carries no internal section numbering.
work.title: Homilies on the Dormition of the Blessed Virgin Mary
